articles.title: Event: Kilonova

Up close: Rough overlapping rings, 30-70 px, drawn as broken specks of amber, copper and golden-white on near-black, packed denser than Bow Shock so little black ground shows between them. Edges are grainy like glowing sand or embers. From a distance: A black car glowing with copper-gold loop fire; reads as hot molten foam or ember lace, warm and glittery. Measured spec (average): metal 151, roughness 87, coat 171. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.
